name: sword
_note: No weapon bones: the model is skinned to the hands. 'active' is the drawn blade (right hand), 'active_optional' the empty scabbard (left hand, hidden while that hand grips the sword in a two-handed move or holds a firearm), 'hidden' the sword in its scabbard (left hand). It rests sheathed; attacks draw it, sword_sheathe / sword_sheathe_moving put it back once a combo ended. Every sword attack begins and ends in the same side-on ready stance (frame 0 of 'start', 105 deg from the idle). Drawn outside an attack (a firearm in the left hand drew it) the body keeps the idle and the arms hold the ready pose; sheathed it is the sword idle with the plain locomotion run. A firearm taking the left hand draws it, one taking both hides it (it comes back sheathed). Blade points: the guard (20 cm up from the pommel) to the tip, in hand_r space (model units, cm).
